summary.headline: Astrology of Runaways and Thieves
summary.text: Astrological rules for locating a runaway or thief: planetary aspects, angular positions, signs, lunar conditions, and house relationships predict capture, informants, hiding places, injuries, companions, physical description, prison, ransom or stolen goods. Authorities include Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mars, Mercury, the Sun, and Moon, with timing of 3, 11, 25, 63, 89, and 170 days.
